evals.prompt: I'm starting a new AI session on a bench with a custom app called 'service_desk'. The app has a few DocTypes and custom hooks. Help me write an AGENTS.md that gives the agent everything it needs to work correctly.
evals.expected_output: A bench-scoped AGENTS.md covering installed apps, version, default site, developer_mode, app conventions, forbidden patterns, and which frappe-* skills apply
expectations: The agent asks for or reads bench version and installed apps before drafting AGENTS.md
The AGENTS.md includes the site name, developer_mode status, and the app's module list
The AGENTS.md lists at least one forbidden pattern specific to Frappe (e.g. no frappe.db.sql, no editing core app files)
The AGENTS.md references at least one frappe-* skill relevant to the task at hand
The file is scoped to this bench — no absolute paths, no client names

evals.prompt: We're halfway through a session and the agent started hallucinating wrong hook names and calling APIs that don't exist. What do I do right now to recover?
evals.expected_output: A concrete recovery sequence: stash work, start a fresh session, re-load AGENTS.md, add the missing context before resuming
expectations: The agent recommends starting a fresh session rather than continuing in the degraded one
The recovery steps include re-reading or updating AGENTS.md before resuming work
The agent identifies at least one likely cause of context rot (e.g. too many tool calls, missing skill context, session too long)
The agent suggests adding specific missing context (e.g. relevant skill, key file path) to AGENTS.md to prevent recurrence
